fixes_applied_in_w_a1.description: Explicitly set encoding='utf-8', errors='replace' on all subprocess.run calls to prevent UnicodeDecodeError ('cp950') when reading UTF-8 symbols from node --test or pytest on Windows.
Aligned environment dependencies and Python version (>=3.12) to match pyproject.toml requirements.

Added Windows-native hardware & OS inventory probes via ctypes GlobalMemoryStatusEx (RAM), GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx (physical cores), winreg CentralProcessor\0 (CPU model), and nvidia-smi + winreg Display fallback (GPU/VRAM).

legacy_posix_findings.detail: Unconditional 'import fcntl' fails on Windows (affects legacy workbench run_jobs and linked_workbench imports).
Uses POSIX-only os.O_NOFOLLOW / os.O_DIRECTORY flags not present in Windows CRT os module.
Uses POSIX-only os.O_NOFOLLOW / os.O_DIRECTORY flags not present in Windows CRT os module.
Creating symlinks on Windows requires elevated privileges or Developer Mode (fails with WinError 1314 without SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege).
Loopback HTTP server sockets fail under sandbox isolation with WinError 10013 / permission denied.
